title: Sublinear Time Eigenvector Approximation via Column Sampling
summary: We study sublinear time sampling methods for approximating the outlying eigenvectors of large matrices. Our main result is an algorithm that uniformly samples just $\tilde{O}(\log n/ε^4)$ columns of a symmetric matrix $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$ with entries bounded in magnitude by $1$, and, for any eigenvalue $λ$ of $A$ with $|λ| \ge εn$, outputs an approximate eigenvector $v$ satisfying $\|Av - λv\|_2 \le εn$.
